title: Slug parameters in main route is incorrect when using intercepted routes

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/mastoj/interceptingbug

### To Reproduce

1. Run application 
2. Click the "Click me"
3. Click the "Click stuff (11111111111)"

### Current vs. Expected behavior

*Actual*
After the last click you should be on the intercepted route: http://localhost:3000/stuff/11111111111. The text in read is from the "main" route, but the slug has now turned into a string instead of an array. I print the text that has an issue in red on the screen.

*Expected*
When I am on the intercepted route http://localhost:3000/stuff/11111111111 I would still expect the main route to have the slug as an array property, or at least be consistent.

### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
  Platform: darwin
  Arch: arm64
  Version: Darwin Kernel Version 22.5.0: Thu Jun  8 22:22:23 PDT 2023; root:xnu-8796.121.3~7/RELEASE_ARM64_T6020
Binaries:
  Node: 18.17.0
  npm: 9.6.7
  Yarn: N/A
  pnpm: 8.6.10
Relevant Packages:
  next: 14.0.5-canary.18
  eslint-config-next: 14.0.4
  react: 18.2.0
  react-dom: 18.2.0
  typescript: 5.3.3
Next.js Config:
  output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

App Router

### Additional context

I tested against latest canary, 14.0.5-canary.18,  and also 14.0.4.
